limitations: This pool exposes source pre-InitFinal physical ownership only. Optional late initialize_navigation now binds actual source floors/obstacles to SAME PFObject (reports/original-actor-navigation-live.json); it does not run Original PhysicalWorld Step, invent collision gameplay delivery, solve original floor positioning, execute a second state machine, or reset actor HP/target. Caller owns all admitted motion and authoritative source pointer-slot state. Tests deliberately reject gameplay contacts rather than claiming complete contact runtime. Old Box2D create_character/CreateShape is not exception-safe if a reached gameplay filter throws during overlapping proxy creation: body/shape may remain before CreateProxy returns. Production must bind real filter providers or treat such allocation failure as unrecoverable native-world boundary; this module does not claim rollback of corrupted broadphase state.
